note: Role collections are created in the BTP cockpit (or btp CLI) because every role template requires the plants attribute: create one role per template and plant set (attribute source: static value, e.g. 1000, or an IdP attribute), then add the roles to these collections. Defined here and checked by test/btp-deployment-config.test.js.

collections.name: AssemblyImpact_JouleReader
collections.description: Joule assistant users (principal propagation): read-only skills, no calculations, no decisions

collections.name: AssemblyImpact_JouleImpactRunner
collections.description: Joule assistant users who may also run the deterministic impact calculation (confirmed per run); no decisions

collections.name: AssemblyImpact_ErpExtractor
collections.description: Designated users who may extract cases from the authorized S/4HANA system
